{{Quote|The senator will be fine. It was only a flesh wound.|Medical droid to Ahsoka Tano on Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Assassin (episode)">{{TCW|Assassin (episode)}}</ref>}}
This '''medical droid''' was on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
In around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] traveled to Alderaan to attend a meeting concerning the refugees displaced by the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] attempted to [[Death/Legends|assassinate]] her while she was giving her speech. Although [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] prevented Aurra Sing from scoring a direct hit, she managed to shoot the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] senator in the arm, knocking her unconscious. This droid treated her and later informed the worried Ahsoka that the senator would be fine as it was only a flesh wound.
